segments.title: Cold Open & Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour countdown; Case Blackwell opens in casual attire, no coat or headphones.

segments.title: Friday News Desk
segments.notes: Stephen Miller named chief of staff after midterm defeat; Testimonium Flavianum analysis suggests later Christian interpolation; Eric Armstrong wins Iowa seat despite suspended campaign; Hakeem Jeffries replacement petition hits 500k with Mark Ruffalo support; Mississippi Senate race too close to call with unknown outstanding ballots; Alaska results still counting.

segments.title: Housekeeping & Segment Planning
segments.notes: Case announces tomorrow noon co-op stream with John Madison; discusses Clem emote redesign; Russell Brand developments; Mississippi/Alaska election updates.

segments.title: Aborted Trent at the Movies / Game Browse
segments.notes: Case solicits co-op horror suggestions for tomorrow; chat recommends dating sims, tactical gay sex dungeon roguelike (Zugs Wang), chair fucking simulator, drug dealer simulator; no trailer reviews conducted.

segments.title: Breaking News: Twinsen's Odyssey
segments.notes: In-game news flash from Little Big Adventure: Twinsen escapes citadel in nurse's uniform, commits misdeeds with magic ball; law enforcement in pursuit.

segments.title: Game Browse Continued
segments.notes: Case reviews Nubbies Number Factory, Sleepy Man music video, Baldi's Fun New School, Police Simulator, Odium Floreo; decides to pivot to Rebuild Rennerton.

segments.title: Rebuild Rennerton: Gooters Castle & Mayoral Election
segments.notes: Skeleton Munch broadcasts from Rennerton wilds; completes Gooters castle (sign misspelled GOONERS); holds press conference fielding questions on Crumb town, hogs, deputy mayor, Gooters G-points, Handem Squid debate moderation, Crum's lawyer; unlimited-points election held; Crumb defeats Munch; Munch concedes and departs; Crumb assumes mayoralty with vegan platform.

segments.title: Studio Wrap-Up & Raid
segments.notes: Case returns to newsroom; Crumb appears in studio (sleeveless); Jo Rogen Experience deferred due to requester Sabreche illness; Gooters logo submissions solicited in Discord; raid executed on Call Me A Rilius.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold-open countdown and sign-on at top of broadcast.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Referenced re: lawyer and Crum Dick Punch; wins Rennerton mayoral election, appears in studio post-stream.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Broadcasts as Skeleton Munch from Rennerton wilds; completes Gooters castle, holds press conference, loses mayoral election to Crumb, concedes and exits.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Butt-dials Case during broadcast; later requests light assistance while Case is in Rennerton.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Mentioned during press conference: crawl spaces banned in Rennerton specifically to keep him out.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a casual Friday broadcast covering Stephen Miller's White House promotion, a scholarly challenge to the Testimonium Flavianum, and midterm election chaos in Mississippi and Iowa. The show pivots to an extended Rebuild Rennerton session where Skeleton Munch completes a Gooters castle, survives a press conference interrupted by Crum's lawyer, and loses a pay-to-play mayoral election to Crum. The stream concludes with Crumb in the studio and a raid on Call Me A Rilius.
